selection_rule: Every remaining unheld SQL record in the fixed cohorts, at all lengths; no substitutions.
findings: Original SQL labels cover schema DDL, a worked query example, an analysis notebook, a database export, a migration, test setup, regression inputs and a query snapshot. Preserve these roles rather than treating every file as a standalone verified program.

One SQL-labelled .cql file contains Clinical Quality Language date/time test definitions. Repeated names may rely on a section loader; the original language label and sampling factors remain unchanged, with observed language recorded separately.

A SQLite-style DDL file lacks closing table delimiters. A PostgreSQL-style analysis notebook mixes repeated table creation, an unbound alias, missing separators and a drop-before-read sequence. These are static supplied-text observations, not measured failures or diagnosed redaction.

CUBRID cast inputs and an Impala query snapshot require their surrounding harness and expected outputs. Materialized-view setup needs refresh/tie-policy context. A test path or optimization example does not establish independent correctness or efficiency evidence.

A database export embeds user-related identifiers, resource URLs and placeholder content alongside its schema. Their synthetic/real status and data-use suitability remain unresolved; literal identifiers are not reproduced in the notes.
No new or reused verified origins for this batch. All previous source-notice questions, family holds and source-use gates remain unresolved.
boundaries: Full static assistant reading, not independent annotation or behavioral verification. No corpus code, database statements, fixtures, compilers, parsers or tests executed; no database, website or external service contacted.

All 218 original identities, token counts, language/license metadata and sampling weights retained; all 44 family holds preserved. No replacement selection, automatic repair, notebook splitting, language relabelling or general rejection filter.
No new acquisition, source-use approval, eligible yield, source ranking, training admission or GPU work. Exact replay validates bookkeeping and recorded inputs, not independent semantic judgments.
next: Finish the remaining 27 unheld records in the fixed cohort, then reconcile provenance, notices, embedded-data suitability, file roles and finite eligible supply in the existing qualification packet before selecting data-study arms.
